referenceName: Groth hospitality research rail and project archive

source.name: Groth Studio
source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested on 2026-09-25 that clearance covers full-page screenshot retention, derivative prompts, and sending screenshots to the pipeline model as visual reference. The source-specific grant was not attached.

provenance.capture: Full-page direct-site captures at 1440x1000 and 390x844 after scrolling the full page to trigger visible reveal content and eager-loading imagery. No gallery screenshot, markup or source asset was saved outside the rendered reference captures.
provenance.attribution: Groth Studio is the captured website. Internal reference only; source screenshots and imagery are not client assets.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A hospitality/interior design practice uses an oversized black wordmark, warm pale mineral portfolio surface, and a narrow bright orange research rail on desktop. The project archive pairs fine line drawings and material/interior photographs with a title and short note. A dark footer closes the experience. On mobile, the sidebar becomes a stackable annotation band and each project becomes a single-column record.

heroGeometry.mode: oversized typographic masthead with side research rail
heroGeometry.alignment: large wordmark and compact practice statement in main column; orange research module occupies a narrow right rail
heroGeometry.viewport: identity, practice scope and project direction are immediately clear without replacing business-specific SEO copy

navigationGeometry.placement: top edge above the large wordmark
navigationGeometry.mobile: menu and essentials in a compact row, with no sticky side rail

typography.scale: oversized wordmark, concise practice title, fine project labels and brief notes

palette.contrastIntent: high contrast at the wordmark and research panel, subdued body palette with legible fine labels

imageTreatment.mode: project photography paired with architectural line drawings
imageTreatment.crop: alternating vertical interior crops and compact drawing previews
imageTreatment.focalPoint: material, spatial layout and detail; no source venue or client identity copied

servicePresentation.pattern: project-led archive followed by a factual hospitality/interior service index
servicePresentation.interaction: direct project links and simple service anchors

ctaPlacement.primary: project enquiry in compact navigation and dark footer
ctaPlacement.early: small enquiry route after the practice statement

motion.primitive: subtle reveal as project records enter the reading area
motion.reducedMotion: static project sequence with all captions visible

rules: move research notes between project groups
